title: Design System: PT Katalis Lintas Global

display.purpose: h1 only, wide 125 heavy uppercase. Hero tightens to clamp(2.1rem, 4.85vw, 4.6rem).

headline.purpose: h2 section titles, wide 125 heavy uppercase, 13 to 18ch.

title.purpose: h3 in plates and timelines, wdth 112, sentence case.

body.purpose: Reading text at normal width, paragraphs capped at 68ch.

lead.purpose: Section and hero ledes, capped at 44rem.

port-line.purpose: Home-port line written under a hero title or the footer name, never above.

label.purpose: Buttons, filters, tags, spec keys, definition terms, dates. Uppercase, tracked 0.05 to 0.08em.

draft-numeral.purpose: Condensed wdth 62 tabular figures for real indices and counts only: draft rail, process steps, locations, meeting steps.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The single easing curve for every transition.

motion.name: plate-color
motion.purpose: Background, color, and border shifts on buttons, header CTA, filters, menu bars.

motion.name: arrow-nudge
motion.purpose: Button arrow moves forward on hover.

motion.name: draft-mark
motion.purpose: Draft rail numeral color flips as it goes under the waterline.

motion.name: waterline
motion.purpose: Waterline height travels to the active section in the draft rail.

motion.name: photo-scale
motion.purpose: Product card photo on card hover.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All animation and transition durations collapse under prefers-reduced-motion; smooth scroll is disabled.

narrative.northStar: Lambung Muara Baru (the painted hull at Muara Baru)
narrative.overview:
Every page reads like the side of a steel fish carrier, top to bottom: a white superstructure header with an ink rule under it, full-width hull-blue fields lettered in wide heavy capitals with the home port written beneath the name, white welded plates of specs and evidence bolted between them, and an oxide-red keel as the footer. Color owns whole horizontal bands; it never arrives as a tint, a badge, or a gradient wash.

The material is flat painted steel. Plates are square, joined by heavy ink rules (3px and 6px) and thin seam lines. Depth comes from band changes (paint, paint-shade, hull, keel) and from rule weight, never from shadow. Numerals are draft marks: condensed, tall, and only ever a real index or count (section order, process step, location number).

The density is a working document's, not a brochure's. Claims sit in a ledger beside their evidence, the specification sheet lists what a buyer agrees in the meeting, and the six locations sit on a real chart of Indonesia. The system rejects the navy-gradient corporate hero with a floating photo and a row of equal rounded cards.
keyCharacteristics: Full-width color bands in a fixed vertical order: paint header, hull fields, paint and paint-shade plates, oxide keel.
Archivo on its width axis: 125 wide heavy caps for hull lettering, 112 for plate labels, 100 for reading, 62 condensed for draft numerals.
Square corners everywhere; heavy ink rules as the joinery.
One seam grid, in sixths of the content container, only on open hull fields.
Draft-mark section rail with a travelling waterline on wide screens.

rules.name: The Waterline Rule
rules.body: Oxide red lives at and below the waterline: the footer keel and the single Muara Baru home-port mark (map pin and list cell). Never use it for buttons, alerts, links, or emphasis anywhere above.

rules.name: The Whole-Band Rule
rules.body: Color is applied as full-width horizontal bands or whole plates. No tinted cards floating on a different tint, no colored chips, no partial washes.

rules.name: The Hull Lettering Rule
rules.body: Wide 125 heavy caps belong to h1, h2, ledger claims, product names, location names, and the footer name. Body copy and h3 never go wide.

rules.name: The Real Numeral Rule
rules.body: A condensed draft numeral must be a true index or count. Never use one as decoration or as a fake statistic.

rules.name: The Port-Below Rule
rules.body: Supporting identity lines go under the title they belong to. No eyebrow or kicker text above headings.

rules.name: The Welded Plate Rule
rules.body: Separate things with ink rules and band changes, never with shadow or blur. If an element needs to stand out, give it a heavier rule or a full band, not a lift.

dos: Do lay color as full-width bands in hull order: paint header, hull fields, paint plates, oxide keel.
Do join plates with ink rules at 3px (`spacing.rule`) and 6px (`spacing.rule-heavy`), and keep every corner square.
Do put the seam grid (sixths of the container, thirds below 780px) only on open hull fields: hero, page hero, CTA band, 404.
Do use wide 125 heavy caps for names and titles, normal width for reading, and condensed 62 numerals only for real indices and counts.
Do write the port line under the title it belongs to.
Do mark every top-level page section with `data-draft` so the draft rail can index it.
donts: Don't use oxide red anywhere above the keel except the single Muara Baru mark.
Don't add eyebrows or kicker lines above headings.
Don't round corners, add shadows, or paint soft or decorative gradients; the only gradients are hard-stop seam and stripe lines.
Don't lay seams over plate structures on a hull field; plates carry their own dividers, never a second grid.
Don't use em dashes in visible copy.
Don't use draft numerals as decoration or invented statistics.
Don't float a photo on a navy gradient or line up a row of equal rounded cards as a hero.
